title: Bounded coherent direct image with proper supports on algebraic spaces
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the unbounded derived categories $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], quasi-coherent modules [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and canonical module functors [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Derived tensor and pullback use K-flat resolutions with flat terms; derived direct image uses K-injective resolutions. Noetherian means quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts. Coherent means quasi-coherent and, on Noetherian affine etale charts, associated to finitely generated modules. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed. The support of a cohomology module is its closed locus of nonzero geometric stalks; it is proper over a base if its reduced induced closed subspace is proper over that base. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type and let $Y$ be Noetherian. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology sheaves, zero outside a finite interval, with each $\operatorname{Supp}H^i(E)$ proper over $Y$. Then $Rf_*E$ has coherent cohomology sheaves, zero outside a finite interval. Neither properness nor quasi-compactness of $f$ is assumed.

proof.text: Choose integers $a\leq b$ with $H^q(E)=0$ outside $[a,b]$ (also for the zero object). By [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], represent $E$ by a complex $K$ zero below $a$. The categories of modules on the small etale ringed sites are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian], with the common universe fixed in the statement. The canonical $f_*$ is additive and left exact: its defining section limits commute with kernels and finite products, or equivalently it is the module right adjoint of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to this functor and $K$. It gives $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*H^q(E)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*E)$, with $p\geq0$, stabilization in each bidegree, and a finite filtration of each abutment with graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,q}$. The K-injective derived functor here is the one in the statement.

source.place: Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent), spectral sequence paragraph; derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor), expressed by the existing truncation spectral sequence.

proof.text: First, $X$ is locally Noetherian: on compatible etale scheme charts apply [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] to the locally finite type map over locally Noetherian $Y$. Fix $q\in[a,b]$ and put $M=H^q(E)$. Its coherent finite-module descriptions on those charts make it finite type and quasi-coherent. By [lem-sfb-space-module-proper-carrier-support], its quasi-coherent annihilator defines $i:Z_M\hookrightarrow X$. On an affine etale chart, for a finite module $N$ and a prime $\mathfrak p$, $N_{\mathfrak p}=0$ exactly when one element outside $\mathfrak p$ annihilates a finite generating set: multiply the finitely many denominators killing those generators. Thus $V(\operatorname{Ann}N)=\operatorname{Supp}N$, the Zariski support of $\widetilde N$. By [lem-sfb-space-etale-chart-support] this Zariski support is the preimage of the geometric-stalk support $\operatorname{Supp}M$ in the chart; since the charts cover $X$, $|Z_M|=\operatorname{Supp}M$. By the equivalence for closed subspaces with the same point set in [lem-sfb-space-proper-support-closed-operations], $Z_M\to Y$ is proper. The carrier equivalence in [lem-sfb-space-module-proper-carrier-support] now supplies a closed immersion $j:W\hookrightarrow X$, a proper map $g=f\circ j:W\to Y$, and a finite type quasi-coherent module $G$ on $W$ with $j_*G\simeq M$. This is done separately for each of the finitely many $q$.

source.place: Tag 0CZI (lemma-module-support-proper-over-base), (1) implies (2) implies (3); the finite-generator localization calculation identifies the two underlying supports.

proof.text: Since $g$ is locally of finite type and $Y$ is locally Noetherian, apply [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] on compatible etale scheme charts. Hence $W$ is locally Noetherian. On a Noetherian affine etale chart $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\to W$, the restriction of $G$ is quasi-coherent and etale locally finitely generated, so by [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence] it is $H_{\mathrm{et}}$ for a quasi-coherent Zariski module $H$ on $V$, which is of finite type by [lem-sfb-scheme-etale-module-exact-finiteness-comparison]. By [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine](a), $N=H(V)$ is a finite $R$-module; [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction](3) gives $H\simeq\widetilde N$, and [lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change] gives $H_{\mathrm{et}}$ the value $B\otimes_RN$ on $\operatorname{Spec}B\to V$. So $G$ is coherent by the convention in the statement. The representable closed immersion $j$ is affine: on every scheme test this is clause (b) of [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc]. Therefore [lem-sfb-space-affine-module-higher-image-vanishing] gives $R^rj_*G=0$ for $r>0$.

source.place: Tag 08GC (lemma-support-proper-over-base-pushforward), proper carrier and closed-immersion acyclicity; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 04ZK (lemma-locally-finite-type-locally-noetherian), reduced to scheme Tag 01T6 on charts.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-ringed-topos-relative-leray] to $j,f,G$. Its page $R^pf_*(R^rj_*G)$ has only row $r=0$, so the finite filtration of the degree-$p$ abutment has a single possible nonzero graded piece. Consequently $R^pf_*M\simeq R^pg_*G$ for all $p\geq0$. By [lem-sfb-space-proper-coherent-higher-images], the right side is coherent: $g$ is proper, $Y$ is locally Noetherian, and $G$ is coherent. For boundedness, $g$ is quasi-compact by properness and quasi-separated because its diagonal is a representable closed immersion, affine on scheme tests by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc]. Since $Y$ is quasi-compact, [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-upper-bound] applied to $G[0]$ supplies $N_q\geq1$ with $R^pg_*G=0$ for $p\geq N_q$. Thus every nonzero row of the page in Step 1 is coherent and vanishes for $p\geq N_q$. The bound is applied only to the proper carrier map $g$.

source.place: Tag 08GC, relative Leray and proper coherence; Tag 08GK, final boundedness sentence, using spaces-cohomology.tex Tag 073G (lemma-vanishing-higher-direct-images), in the derived form of Tag 08FA.

proof.text: All $E_2$ terms of Step 1 are coherent, including zero terms. By [lem-sfb-space-coherent-kernel-cokernel-extension] on the locally Noetherian target $Y$, kernels, cokernels and extensions of coherent modules are coherent. For every page, its differential is between coherent modules; its image is the kernel of its cokernel, and the next page is the quotient of its kernel by that image. Induction therefore makes every finite page coherent. The stabilization and finite abutment filtrations of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] identify each $E_\infty$ term with a finite page and each graded piece with such a term. Starting at the zero end of each finite filtration and taking successive extensions proves coherence of every $H^n(Rf_*E)$. No closure under arbitrary submodules or infinite extensions is used.

source.place: Tag 08GK, coherence from the spectral sequence; spaces-cohomology.tex Tag 07UC (lemma-coherent-abelian-Noetherian), in the cited kernel/cokernel/extension form.

proof.text: Let $N=\max\{N_q:a\leq q\leq b\}$; this is a maximum of a finite nonempty family. The page $E_2^{p,q}$ is zero unless $p\geq0$ and $a\leq q\leq b$, and is also zero when $p\geq N$. Hence for $n<a$ or $n\geq b+N$, every term with $p+q=n$ is zero: in the latter case $q\leq b$ forces $p\geq N$. All subsequent pages at these bidegrees remain zero. The finite, exhaustive, separated filtrations of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] then have every graded piece zero, so their abutments are zero by induction on filtration length. Thus $H^n(Rf_*E)=0$ outside $[a,b+N-1]$, proving boundedness as well as the coherence already established. If all cohomology modules vanish, choose the empty proper carrier and $N_q=1$ throughout; the same argument gives zero abutment.

source.place: Tag 08GK, boundedness below and above, with the finite maximum and the zero graded-piece argument written explicitly.

lean.statement: theorem derivedDirectImage_bounded_coherent_of_proper_support {S : Scheme.{u}} {X Y : AlgebraicSpace S} [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} Y.SmallModules] (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : MapIsLocally (@LocallyOfFiniteType) f) (hYln : ∀ T : Y.EtaleSite, IsLocallyNoetherian (Y.etaleForget.obj T)) (hYqc : CompactSpace (Point Y.obj.obj)) (hYqs : ∀ (U V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left → IsAffine V.left → CompactSpace (Point (Limits.pullback a b))) (E : X.DerivedModules) (hcoh : ∀ i : ℤ, (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj E)).IsQuasicoherent ∧ ∀ T : X.EtaleSite, IsAffine (X.etaleForget.obj T) → Module.Finite Γ(X.etaleForget.obj T, ⊤) Γ((X.schemeRestriction T).obj (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj E)), ⊤)) (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj E)) (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ (Z : AlgebraicSpace S) (j : Z ⟶ X), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) j.hom.hom ∧ IsReduced Z ∧ pointImage j.hom.hom = moduleSupport (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj E)) ∧ MapIsProper (j ≫ f)) : (∀ i : ℤ, (Y.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.SmallModules i).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj E))).IsQuasicoherent ∧ ∀ T : Y.EtaleSite, IsAffine (Y.etaleForget.obj T) → Module.Finite Γ(Y.etaleForget.obj T, ⊤) Γ((Y.schemeRestriction T).obj (Y.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.SmallModules i).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj E))), ⊤)) ∧ (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.SmallModules i).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj E)))
